description: Baseline composition for loading the alenger-heart source's 3疯批帝国.SC2Mod into Dead of Night. Replaces the legacy-project 7vs1/Alenger3 + commanderBaseMods chain with the alenger-heart 3疯批帝国 + 通用效果 pair, mirroring the user-requested runtime load. Deliberately omits CoreRuntime / CommanderBridge / BaseCatalogPatch / SharedUnits / ExternalRefs / kit_mutations / AlengerCommon / Alenger3Adapter so we can statically verify the alenger-heart composition does not introduce the LibDF8E6945_h missing-include that the legacy composition hit.
